lines.zh: 我飘过走廊，脚不碰地。
lines.en: I drift down the corridor without touching ground.

lines.zh: 草叶被我带起一阵凉风。
lines.en: My passing stirs a cold wind in the grass.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根滑，像一层霜。
lines.en: I slide along the wall like a skin of frost.

lines.zh: 我向前飘，灯焰朝我弯。
lines.en: I move forward and the flame bends to me.

lines.zh: 地面结霜，跟着我的方向。
lines.en: Frost forms on the floor and follows me.

lines.zh: 我不走，我只是一点点靠近。
lines.en: I do not walk; I simply inch nearer.

lines.zh: 经过麦田，麦子都低下头。
lines.en: The wheat bows as I pass through it.

lines.zh: 我绕开那扇有阳光的窗。
lines.en: I skirt that window where the sun comes in.

lines.zh: 我飘得很慢，这样才吓人。
lines.en: I drift slowly, and that is what frightens.

lines.zh: 影子先动，我随后到。
lines.en: My shadow moves first; I arrive after.

lines.zh: 我穿过门板，木纹擦过我。
lines.en: I pass through planks and the grain scrapes me.

lines.zh: 我上升半尺，又沉下去。
lines.en: I rise half a foot, then settle back down.

lines.zh: 我悬在房梁下，慢慢转圈。
lines.en: I hang under the beam and turn slowly.

lines.zh: 有人在屋里哭，我去听听。
lines.en: Someone is weeping indoors; I go to listen.

lines.zh: 我没有呼吸，却有回声。
lines.en: I have no breath, yet I make an echo.

lines.zh: 窗外的光太亮，我往暗处缩。
lines.en: The window is too bright; I shrink to shade.

lines.zh: 我碰到镜子，镜面就白了。
lines.en: I touch the mirror and it fogs over.

lines.zh: 外面有人念我的名字。
lines.en: Someone outside is speaking my name.

lines.zh: 我绕着柱子转了三圈。
lines.en: I circle the pillar three times over.

lines.zh: 屋顶漏风，我正好在风口。
lines.en: The roof leaks air; I sit in the draft.

lines.zh: 我记得这间屋子的旧样子。
lines.en: I remember what this room used to be.

lines.zh: 我低下头，像在想什么。
lines.en: I bow my head as if remembering something.

lines.zh: 钟响了，我没数第几下。
lines.en: The bell rang; I lost count of the strokes.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙上，变成一片凉。
lines.en: I flatten on the wall and become a chill.

lines.zh: 我在门槛上停住，不进去。
lines.en: I stop at the threshold and do not enter.

lines.zh: 窗纸响了一下，是我吹的。
lines.en: The window paper rustles—my breath did that.

lines.zh: 我飘过去，把烛火压低一点。
lines.en: I drift over and press the candle flame lower.

lines.zh: 墙角有只蛛，我陪它待着。
lines.en: There's a spider in the corner. I keep it company.

lines.zh: 你呵出的白气，我几年没见了。
lines.en: I have not seen breath steam in years.

lines.zh: 你瞳孔缩了一下，是看见了。
lines.en: Your pupils shrank—so you did see me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的喉咙，跳得快。
lines.en: I watch your throat; it pulses very fast.

lines.zh: 你的灯照不穿我。
lines.en: Your lamp cannot shine through me.

lines.zh: 我认得这种害怕的味道。
lines.en: I know the smell of this particular fear.

lines.zh: 你活着，真好。
lines.en: You are alive. That is very good.

lines.zh: 你往后挪，我就贴上来半寸。
lines.en: You edge back; I close the gap by inches.

lines.zh: 我数你的睫毛，一根一根。
lines.en: I count your lashes, one at a time.

lines.zh: 你没见过死在半路的东西吧。
lines.en: You have never met something that died midway.

lines.zh: 我把脸凑近，你还能呼吸吗？
lines.en: I bring my face close—can you still breathe?

lines.zh: 你的影子和我重叠了一瞬。
lines.en: Your shadow and mine overlapped for a moment.

lines.zh: 别看我的脚，我没有。
lines.en: Do not look at my feet; I have none.

lines.zh: 我把你记进夜里的名单。
lines.en: I write you into the list of the night.

lines.zh: 你笑起来像还没死的人。
lines.en: You smile like someone not yet dead.

lines.zh: 我散开又聚拢，这一刀白费。
lines.en: I scatter and reform; your cut was wasted.

lines.zh: 痛感很淡，像隔着水。
lines.en: The pain is faint, as if through water.

lines.zh: 你把我的雾打薄了一层。
lines.en: You thinned the mist of me a little.

lines.zh: 我退到暗处，你追不上。
lines.en: I fade into the dark; you cannot follow.

lines.zh: 剑穿过我，只带走一缕凉。
lines.en: The sword passes through and takes one chill.

lines.zh: 别以为打中我了。
lines.en: Do not think that actually hit me.

lines.zh: 我发抖，不是害怕，是生气。
lines.en: I tremble—not from fear, but from anger.

lines.zh: 这一下，像极了咽气那晚。
lines.en: This feels just like the night I stopped breathing.

lines.zh: 我塌了一角，会补回来。
lines.en: A corner of me collapsed; it will mend.

lines.zh: 你再打，我就更冷。
lines.en: Strike again and I grow colder still.

lines.zh: 供桌上的冷饭，我闻到了。
lines.en: Cold rice on the altar—I smell it.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我想靠近。
lines.en: I do not eat, but I want to be near it.

lines.zh: 那张纸钱，是烧给谁的？
lines.en: That paper money—who was it burned for?

lines.zh: 你手里的香，让我想起家。
lines.en: The incense in your hand reminds me of home.

lines.zh: 灯芯上的火，比食物好。
lines.en: The flame on the wick is better than food.

lines.zh: 你把碗放下，我就过来。
lines.en: Set the bowl down and I will come over.

lines.zh: 我尝不出味道，只记得样子。
lines.en: I taste nothing; I only remember the shape.

lines.zh: 别点灯，我更喜欢你的呼吸。
lines.en: No lamp, please—I prefer your breathing.

lines.zh: 这碗汤冒烟，像我的样子。
lines.en: This soup steams like something I resemble.

lines.zh: 给我留一盏灯，只留一盏。
lines.en: Leave me one lamp, just one lamp.

lines.zh: 你穿过了我，半边身子发冷。
lines.en: You passed through me; half of you went cold.

lines.zh: 我不重，撞上来只有风。
lines.en: I have no weight; you only hit cold air.

lines.zh: 别慌，冷的只是一会儿。
lines.en: Do not panic; the cold lasts only a while.

lines.zh: 我的形状被撞散了，又合上。
lines.en: My shape scatters, then closes up again.

lines.zh: 你撞向墙，我却在你身后。
lines.en: You hit the wall; I am behind you still.

lines.zh: 碰到我的人，会长一层白霜。
lines.en: Those who touch me grow a coat of frost.

lines.zh: 你的火把往旁边歪了一下。
lines.en: Your torch leans sideways for a moment.

lines.zh: 我退开，让你走过去。
lines.en: I withdraw and let you walk past.

lines.zh: 我们的影子撞在一起，分不开。
lines.en: Our shadows collided and would not part.

lines.zh: 别碰第二次，我会记住。
lines.en: Do not touch me twice; I will remember.

lines.zh: 我在空屋里等了你很久。
lines.en: I have waited in this empty house for you.

lines.zh: 两团冷气挨着，就不算冷。
lines.en: Two patches of cold together hardly feel cold.

lines.zh: 我们没有影子，就共用一个。
lines.en: We have no shadows; let us share one.

lines.zh: 你愿意跟我飘一夜吗？
lines.en: Will you drift with me for one night?

lines.zh: 我把你的名字念给风听。
lines.en: I speak your name aloud to the wind.

lines.zh: 别怕我凉，凉久了就习惯。
lines.en: Do not fear my chill; you get used to it.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一根柱子转。
lines.en: We will circle the same pillar together.

lines.zh: 灯灭的时候，你还在吗？
lines.en: When the lamp dies, will you still be there?

lines.zh: 我不需要心跳来认你。
lines.en: I do not need a heartbeat to know you.

lines.zh: 百年很长，我们慢慢飘。
lines.en: A century is long; we will drift slowly.

lines.zh: 我想捡那枚戒指，手穿过去。
lines.en: I reach for the ring; my hand passes through.

lines.zh: 东西落在我怀里，又掉下去。
lines.en: It rests in my arms a moment, then falls.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只好把它吹到墙角。
lines.en: No hands—so I blow it into the corner.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，我替你看着。
lines.en: You dropped something; I will watch it.

lines.zh: 这枚铜钱，我碰不到。
lines.en: This copper coin—I cannot touch it.

lines.zh: 我心里想着它，它就飘一点。
lines.en: I think at it, and it drifts a little.

lines.zh: 我推不动刀，只好绕开。
lines.en: I cannot push the blade; I go around it.

lines.zh: 那张纸被我吹起来了。
lines.en: That sheet of paper lifts at my breath.

lines.zh: 沉的东西，我留给你捡。
lines.en: Heavy things I leave for you to lift.

lines.zh: 它穿过我的身体，响了一声。
lines.en: It passed through me and made a sound.

lines.zh: 羽毛落了，你就在这道风里。
lines.en: A feather fell; you are inside that wind.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的温度了。
lines.en: I have caught the warmth coming off you.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了地上的白霜。
lines.en: You crushed the white frost on the floor.

lines.zh: 我本来要睡，现在不睡了。
lines.en: I meant to sleep; I am not sleeping now.

lines.zh: 你点了灯，我就找到你了。
lines.en: You lit a lamp, so I found you.

lines.zh: 我认得你那盏灯的颜色。
lines.en: I know the color of that lantern of yours.

lines.zh: 名单上本来没有你，现在有了。
lines.en: You were not on the list; now you are.

lines.zh: 你听见风停了吗？那是我。
lines.en: Did the wind stop? That was me.

lines.zh: 我绕到你的背后了。
lines.en: I have come around behind you now.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在楼下停了。
lines.en: Your footsteps stopped downstairs just now.

lines.zh: 我和你有旧账，你忘了。
lines.en: We have an old debt; you forgot it.

lines.zh: 今晚我跟着你走。
lines.en: Tonight I will follow wherever you go.

lines.zh: 我把冷气收拢，围住你的脚。
lines.en: I gather my cold and ring your ankles.

lines.zh: 你不该停在这间屋子里。
lines.en: You should not have stopped in this room.

lines.zh: 我的影子爬上你的后背。
lines.en: My shadow climbs onto your back.

lines.zh: 我把门关上了，风关的。
lines.en: I closed the door—the wind did it.

lines.zh: 你的手在找出口，我知道。
lines.en: Your hand is hunting a way out; I know.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，不让地板响。
lines.en: I come nearer without a creak from the boards.

lines.zh: 霜从你的鞋底往上长。
lines.en: Frost grows upward from your soles.

lines.zh: 你不敢眨眼，我一闪就没了。
lines.en: You dare not blink; one flicker and I am gone.

lines.zh: 我堵住窗，光进不来。
lines.en: I block the window; no light enters.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变成白雾了。
lines.en: Your breath has turned to white mist.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子走，越贴越近。
lines.en: I walk your shadow's edge, pressing closer.

lines.zh: 别数到十，我等不了那么久。
lines.en: Do not count to ten; I cannot wait that long.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，指尖在你颈后。
lines.en: I reach out; my fingertips are at your neck.

lines.zh: 我一碰，你的腿就沉了。
lines.en: One touch and your legs grow heavy.

lines.zh: 冷绳缠上你的脚踝，收紧了。
lines.en: Cold cords wrap your ankles and draw tight.

lines.zh: 你慢了，走一步像三步。
lines.en: You are slowed; one step feels like three.

lines.zh: 我的手穿进你的胸口，凉。
lines.en: My hand goes through your chest—so cold.

lines.zh: 别扯那根冷绳，会勒进肉。
lines.en: Do not pull the cold cord; it bites deeper.

lines.zh: 疼痛会过去，僵硬不会。
lines.en: The pain passes; the stiffness does not.

lines.zh: 你抬不起刀了，对。
lines.en: You cannot lift the blade now. Good.

lines.zh: 我把霜吹进你的关节。
lines.en: I blow frost into every one of your joints.

lines.zh: 你眨眼变慢了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your blinking has slowed; I noticed that.

lines.zh: 接下来你只能站着听完。
lines.en: From here you can only stand and listen.

lines.zh: 我从地板底下渗上来，先是一层白。
lines.en: I seep up through the boards, white at first.

lines.zh: 霜先到，我后到。
lines.en: The frost arrives first; I come after.

lines.zh: 这屋子空了太久，我醒了。
lines.en: This house stood empty too long; I woke.

lines.zh: 月亮被云挡住，正好。
lines.en: The moon is behind cloud—just right.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，墙上的钟停了。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, the clock stopped.

lines.zh: 有人在楼下敲了三下。
lines.en: Someone knocked three times downstairs.

lines.zh: 我带着一股旧木头的气味。
lines.en: I bring the smell of old timber with me.

lines.zh: 这地方冷，我选对了。
lines.en: It is cold here; I chose well.

lines.zh: 蜡烛自己亮了，我在旁边。
lines.en: The candle lit itself; I was beside it.

lines.zh: 我从一段没人记得的事里来。
lines.en: I come from a thing nobody remembers.

lines.zh: 夜露落在草上，我出现了。
lines.en: Dew settled on the grass and I appeared.

lines.zh: 我数过了，屋里有四个活人。
lines.en: I counted four living people in this house.

lines.zh: 轮廓还在晃，像没干的墨。
lines.en: My outline still wavers like wet ink.

lines.zh: 风推开门，我借机进来。
lines.en: The wind pushed the door; I walked in with it.

lines.zh: 火烫到我的雾，嘶了一声。
lines.en: Fire touched my mist and it hissed.

lines.zh: 我往下沉，撞到自己的影子。
lines.en: I sink and strike my own shadow.

lines.zh: 水浇透了我，我变得很重。
lines.en: Water soaks through me and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹成一团乱雾。
lines.en: The blast scatters me into tangled mist.

lines.zh: 箭从我的胸口穿出，扎进门板。
lines.en: The arrow leaves my chest and bites the door.

lines.zh: 符咒贴上来，我僵了一下。
lines.en: The charm clings and I stiffen briefly.

lines.zh: 我不吃，饿的只是这具空壳。
lines.en: I do not eat; only the shell is hungry.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我的轮廓亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Thunder sounds and my outline flashes white.

lines.zh: 下面没有底，我往下坠。
lines.en: There is no floor; I fall and keep falling.
